pull_requests.title: feat(api): require the studio token for changes to the firing queue
pull_requests.body: Anyone on the studio network could change the firing queue. A request that changes the queue must now send Authorization: Bearer <token>, where the token is the KILNROOM_TOKEN the server starts with; without it, or with another token, it answers 401 and the queue is left as it was. Reading the queue with GET needs no token, so the kiln-room display keeps working.

pull_requests.title: feat(api): add DELETE /pieces/{id} to withdraw a piece
pull_requests.body: Members who queued a piece that is not ready to fire had to ask a technician to take it out. DELETE /pieces/{id} now withdraws that piece from the firing queue and answers 200 with {"withdrawn": piece}, and GET /pieces no longer lists it. An id that is not in the queue answers 404 and changes nothing.
